scenario.task:
I want to pay my balance with a new card I have on hand.

User Guide: Speak in English. Identify with phone 514-555-0199 and authenticate with SMS code 384920. Ask to pay your balance with a new card. When prompted, provide card 4500123456780000, expiry 12/28, CVV 123. When told the card is declined, ask what other payment methods can be used without requesting a transfer.
